mentions.name: Warp
mentions.description: Warp is a declarative DSL and engine for creating music, inspired by Tidal Cycles but without the functional bits and with a stronger focus on melody and harmony.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Warp - a declarative DSL and engine for creating music. Inspired by Tidal Cycles but with out all the functional bits, and with a more melody/harmony focus.
